behaviours.description: Reset values: o_halt, o_err_illegal, o_sts_done and o_result_label are 0; o_uart_tx is 1.
Host port: DMEM byte-masked write, read-back 1 cycle later, back-to-back reads, IMEM read returns 0, MMIO and unmapped reads return 0, MMIO and unmapped writes change nothing.
Scalar program with MMIO sw/lw, load-use and ebreak: label, sts.done and halt without o_err_illegal.
mul result and a taken branch that skips an instruction.
Reset clears outputs while DMEM contents are kept.
Illegal instruction (div) halts the core and sets o_err_illegal; the following instruction does not execute.
sb to MMIO gives PSLVERR and sets sts.err, with no halt and a normal ack.
UART 8N1 frame of 0xA3 at baud_div = 8: start bit, data LSB first, stop bit.
VPU smoke: vsetivli (vl = 4), vmv.v.x, vmv.x.s, vle32, vse32 with results checked through the label and the DMEM read-back.
i_ld_en was never 1 while i_rst_n_core was 1 (assertion, REQ-IF-009 / SVA-001).

New: an illegal instruction (div) and an ebreak in the wrong-path shadow of a taken beq do not halt the core and do not set sts.err or o_err_illegal. The program reaches the target, reads sts.err as 0 and writes label 5.
New: a store and a load at the unimplemented MMIO offset 0x40 read 0, do not hang or halt, and leave defined registers working (label 3).
New: after a vsetivli, cycles.cnt (offset 0x0C) is at least 5, the minimum 6-state ctrl latency. The label is 1 if cnt >= 5.

summary: Kept the existing testbench and added three behaviours for the new requirements: S11 for REQ-084, S12 for REQ-086 and S13 for REQ-087. REQ-085 is not tested, because its read data and `sts.err` are unspecified. The REQ-008, REQ-054, REQ-058, REQ-062, REQ-074 and REQ-075 changes need deeper vector or misaligned-access tests than a smoke test. `smoke_run` passes all 13 behaviours.
